## Description {#details}

<p>This file contains the declaration of the GlobalIFunc class, which represents a single indirect function in the IR.</p>


<p>Indirect function uses ELF symbol type extension to mark that the address of a declaration should be resolved at runtime by calling a resolver function.</p>
